# Festivo AI

> AI-powered event planning assistant for weddings, birthdays, college celebrations, and community events.

## Overview

Festivo AI helps you turn an event brief into an editable budget, timeline, vendor checklist, and AI-generated improvement proposals while preserving explicit user approval.

## Features

- [Event Planning](https://festivoai01.vercel.app/) - Create and manage events with comprehensive details
- [Budget Management](https://festivoai01.vercel.app/app) - Decimal-safe budget planning with expense tracking
- [Timeline Generation](https://festivoai01.vercel.app/app) - Automated timeline creation and task management
- [Vendor Management](https://festivoai01.vercel.app/app) - Vendor checklists, quotes, and booking management
- [AI Suggestions](https://festivoai01.vercel.app/app) - Gemini-backed AI planning with human approval workflow

## Usage

Visit [Festivo AI](https://festivoai01.vercel.app/) to get started. Sign up or use the demo account to explore the platform.
